note: Facility registry (20 r2 section 3.4). One entry per priced facility; adding a facility is a data change. Every holiday list names its source.

facilities.cards_note: One card per rate year; a trip is priced by the card in force on its entry date (America/Toronto). 2027 rates announced 2026-11-20, effective 2027-01-01, and add a weekday 12:30 p.m. band.

continuation.note: Highway 407 East, Brock Road (Pickering) to Highway 35/115 (Clarington): the MTO's section, toll-free since 2025-06-01. Its own shape (corridors/407-east.json, OSM relation 6328033, build_407_east.py) recognises it: the ETR corridor's extended last segment drifts up to 2.6 km away. A traversal with both edges on it (past Brock Road, within 300 m of the shape) is NOT_BILLABLE under facility 407-east; one that continues past Brock Road is priced by the ETR up to Brock Road (mixedOperators). Before 2025-06-01 the MTO tolled it and no card is loaded, so such trips are NO_RATE. Hwy 412 and 418 have been toll-free since 2022 and are not on the corridor.
sources: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/6328033 (note: Hwy 407 is entirely toll-free as of June 1, 2025)

holidays.note: ETR names no holidays; it says Ontario statutory holidays, which the Employment Standards Act lists as these nine. Civic Holiday, Easter Monday and Remembrance Day are NOT included. date_rule=actual: a holiday falling on a weekend is weekend-priced anyway, and no substitute weekday is assumed (ETR publishes none) - verify against a statement.

facilities.ramp_rule_note: A ramp plaza is charged only when a GPS fix lies within 20 m of that ramp's OSM shape and at least 30 m from the mainline (decided 2026-11-06). Distance to the booth is never used: 30 of 61 CFX ramp booth clusters lie within 50 m of the mainline. Sparse fixes can miss a ramp, so CFX estimates may still run slightly low; 4 ramp clusters cannot be proven (Schofield Road's 2, which have no OSM ramp shape; Boggy Creek/McCoy and Semoran, which never separate 30 m from the mainline) and are never charged.
facilities.rate_schedule: single rate, all days and times: the CFX schedule publishes no peak, off-peak or holiday rates

facilities.cards_note: Each passage is charged from the card in effect on its Chicago-local date. The board approved the 2027 card on 2026-08-19; from 2029 rates move every two years by CPI-U (max 8%), so a new card is due before 2029-01-01.
facilities.payment_column_note: Fleet decision 2026-11-06: vehicles hold no I-PASS or other transponder and their plates are not registered, so each toll is billed by invoice. 2026: Pay Online rate plus a $3 fee per toll (the 2026 table has no invoice column; the card derives it). 2027: the published Invoice rate, 2x I-PASS, no per-toll fee - so an invoiced passenger toll gets CHEAPER on 2027-01-01 (Touhy 4.90 -> 3.00). Later-stage escalation (extra fees after 90 days, $20 violation fines after 120) is not estimated.
facilities.ramp_rule_note: As CFX: a ramp plaza is charged only when a fix lies within 20 m of the ramp's OSM shape and at least 30 m from the mainline. Eola Road (60) and Ogden Avenue (81) are mainline on the card but every gantry sits on a ramp, so they take the ramp rule. Where one plaza number is priced per movement (Genoa Road, Illinois 47, Barrington Road, Roselle Road) the ramp's geometry picks the movement; see gantries/istha.json.
facilities.rate_schedule: passenger rates have a single rate, all days and times; only truck rates vary (daytime/overnight)

facilities.cards_note: The rates page states no effective date; the card is dated from the earliest archived copy that shows these rates (see the card's source_note). E-470 reprices on 1 January when its board changes rates.
facilities.payment_column_note: Fleet decision 2026-11-06: no ExpressToll or other transponder, plates not registered, so every toll is a License Plate Toll. A statement paid late adds a one-time $5 fee (not estimated).
facilities.ramp_rule_note: As CFX: a toll ramp is charged only when a fix lies within 20 m of the ramp's OSM shape and at least 30 m from the mainline. Every toll ramp has one rate, so the interchange is only noted (gantries/e470.json); the debounce is per plaza, so leaving and re-entering through toll ramps within 120 s is charged once.
facilities.rate_schedule: 2-axle rates are a single rate, all days and times

facilities.cards_note: Rates effective 2026-05-01; the page announces changes under 'Pending Toll Rates' (none on 2026-11-06).
facilities.payment_column_note: Fleet decision 2026-11-06: no ExpressToll transponder, so each toll adds the $1.35 per-transaction processing fee (derived in the card). The $0.90 mailing fee per bill and late fees are not estimated.
facilities.ramp_rule_note: As CFX: a ramp (US 287/Dillon Road, Sheridan Boulevard) is charged only when a fix lies within 20 m of the ramp's OSM shape and at least 30 m from the mainline.
facilities.rate_schedule: two bands by local time, every day: 06:00-21:00 and 21:00-06:00; the band at the moment of each passage applies

facilities.display_name: Florida's Turnpike and FDOT toll facilities
facilities.cards_note: One card for the six regional schedules, dated from the newest table (Central Florida, 2026-08-14); each row is priced from its own table's effective date (GantrySet.rowStart: Beachline West and Dallas from 2026-07-01, Gateway from 2024-05-03, Leesburg from 2026-08-14), and a passage before its row's date is NO_RATE. The Garcon Point Bridge is on Central time; its only effect is at a rate's start midnight.
facilities.payment_column_note: Fleet decision 2026-11-06: no SunPass or interoperable transponder, so every toll is TOLL-BY-PLATE. FTE adds a $2.50 administrative fee per 30-day invoice (not estimated, it is per bill).
facilities.ramp_rule_note: As CFX: an interchange is charged only when a fix lies within 20 m of a ramp's OSM shape and at least 30 m from the mainline and from the road the ramp meets. The Beachline West and Dallas plazas are shared with CFX (each charges a portion at the same gantry) and are charged once per facility. Alligator Alley and the Sunshine Skyway charge one direction at each end (charged_bearing in gantries/fte.json, from the FDOT schedule maps). See gantries/fte.json for rows not on the map and for toll points deliberately never charged.
facilities.rate_schedule: single rate, all days and times

facilities.timezone_note: Quebec observes Eastern time; America/Toronto is the IANA zone (America/Montreal is a deprecated link to it).
facilities.cards_note: The grid in force from 2026-02-28; the operator's fee page says it runs to 2027-01-31, and the next grid is published in the Gazette officielle du Quebec. A passage before 2026-02-28 is NO_RATE.
facilities.payment_column_note: The A-30 has no plate or transponder premium: the booth charges the same toll by credit or debit card (cash not accepted) as by transponder. Fleet vehicles (light, under 230 cm, 2 axles) are Categorie B. A vehicle that passes without paying owes an 8.00 $ recovery fee per passage on top (37.00 $ after a further 7 days); not estimated.
facilities.ramp_rule_note: No ramp tolls: the only toll is the station on the Saint Lawrence crossing (pont P-10942), charged in both directions.
facilities.rate_schedule: single rate, all days and times: the grid prints the same amount for every period
